file_summary.title: Database file census
file_summary.summary: Counts and byte totals come from one complete original native file census.
limitations: This summary covers native ROWS (type 0) and LOG (type 1) file entries. Other file types are counted separately and excluded from these byte totals.
Catalog LOG allocation includes every reported type 1 entry and may include a persistent log buffer. It is not effective transaction-log capacity.
Filegroup aggregates overlap these file rows and are not added. Transaction-log DMV quantities keep their own observation clock and are not combined with these totals.

The database ID and UTC belong to this original census. They do not establish a database incarnation, continuous history, host disk space or another replica’s allocation. These are reported catalog values, not an atomic snapshot of physical space use.

exact.title: Storage allocations and files
exact.summary: Recorded allocation populations and visible database files retain their own native meaning.
limitations: Log, writable online data-filegroup capacity and shared temporary allocation are separate populations. They are not added into a database total.
The file list contains visible catalog rows, including read-only and offline files. File type, sparse-file and snapshot size meanings remain distinct; missing used space is unknown.
Configured growth and maximum-size values do not measure filesystem headroom, physical disk use or a verified usable restore.
